card.name: Spots where the word manual comes next
card.fires_on: Fires on a word just before an expected 'manual' or 'manually', such as 'or' after 'automatically' or 'performing' before 'manual tasks'. It also fires on small linking words in lists of mental or physical abilities.

modes.label: Automatic versus manual
modes.description: A linking word after 'automatically' or 'assisted' that sets up a manual alternative.

modes.label: Before manual tasks or manuals
modes.description: A word right before 'manual' as a task type or a reference manual title.
modes.example: learning,<< performing>> manual tasks, seeing, speaking, walking

modes.label: Mental or physical ability lists
modes.description: A linking word in warnings about mental and physical or motor abilities.
modes.example: may impair the mental<< or>> physical abilities needed to perform potentially hazardous activities
